tests.name: slope_ratio_discrimination_test
tests.comparison: ma10_slope_5 / ma20_slope_5 ratio calculated at snapshot; ruination vs selected_winner groups compared via Mann-Whitney U on ratio values
tests.success_criterion: Ratio median for false_positive_ruin cases is statistically significantly lower (p<0.05) than ratio median for selected_winner cases, and ratio threshold of 1.0 achieves >70% separation accuracy
tests.failure_criterion: No significant difference in ratio distributions between outcome groups, OR ratio threshold of 1.0 produces <60% separation—invalidating slope-ratio-as-gate claim

tests.name: volume_ratio_standalone_test
tests.comparison: Direct comparison of vol_ratio_5_20 distributions between false_positive_ruin and selected_winner without conditioning on any momentum features; test whether vol_ratio alone discriminates
tests.success_criterion: vol_ratio_5_20 median for false_positive_ruin is significantly lower (p<0.05) than selected_winner, AND vol_ratio < 1.0 predicts ruin in >75% of applicable cases
tests.failure_criterion: vol_ratio_5_20 distributions are statistically indistinguishable between outcome groups (p>0.1), OR vol_ratio < 1.0 appears in selected_winner cases at comparable frequency to ruin cases—falsifying volume-dry-up mechanism

tests.name: momentum_only_test
tests.comparison: Test whether mom_20 AND ma10_slope_5 together (without volume) can discriminate ruin vs winner; addresses skeptic's claim that vol_ratio_5_20 is backward-looking and redundant with recent momentum
tests.success_criterion: Combination of mom_20 < 0.08 AND ma10_slope_5 < 0.02 predicts false_positive_ruin in >70% of cases where both conditions hold
tests.failure_criterion: Momentum-only features produce no significant discrimination (AUC < 0.6 for ruin vs winner), indicating volume features are necessary for prediction

tests.name: within_snapshot_regime_test
tests.comparison: Identify snapshots containing both false_positive_ruin and selected_winner B0 picks; test whether feature values overlap within regime, directly testing skeptic's claim that features cannot discriminate within market regime
tests.success_criterion: No snapshot contains mixed outcome B0 picks with identical vol_ratio_5_20 (±0.1) AND identical ma10_slope_5 (±0.01) AND identical mom_20 (±0.02)—demonstrating features do discriminate within regime
tests.failure_criterion: At least one snapshot shows false_positive_ruin and selected_winner with overlapping feature values within stated tolerances—falsifying feature discriminability within regime

tests.name: hybrid_label_ambiguity_test
tests.comparison: Quantify contamination from entity_6618d3e80c (dual-labeled false_positive_ruin|selected_winner) and any other multi-outcome entities; test sensitivity of pattern to their exclusion
tests.success_criterion: Removing dual-labeled entities changes ruin vs winner median for vol_ratio_5_20 by <0.05 AND changes slope ratio median by <0.1—demonstrating robustness to labeling ambiguity
tests.failure_criterion: Removing dual-labeled entities flips the sign of median difference between outcome groups for any feature, OR causes statistically significant shift in distributions—revealing pattern is labeling-dependent

tests.name: ibd_entry_distance_decay_test
tests.comparison: Test whether ibd_entry_close_vs_trigger_pct (distance from trigger) moderates vol_ratio_5_20's predictive power; addresses researcher claim that entry quality interacts with volume confirmation
tests.success_criterion: Among B0 picks with vol_ratio_5_20 > 1.3, those with ibd_entry_close_vs_trigger_pct > 0.04 show ruin rate < 20%, while those with ibd_entry_close_vs_trigger_pct < 0.02 show ruin rate > 50%
tests.failure_criterion: ibd_entry_close_vs_trigger_pct does not moderate vol_ratio_5_20's relationship to outcome (no significant interaction in logistic regression)

leakage_checks: pullback_duration_weeks and pullback_pct excluded from all test features—these are post-snapshot observables unavailable at decision time
w4_return_bucket excluded from test features—it's an outer-forward outcome, not a PIT feature
snapshot_anon used only for regime stratification in within_snapshot_regime_test, never as a predictor feature

All slope ratios computed from same 5-day window (ma10_slope_5, ma20_slope_5) must be flagged as potentially redundant per skeptic's circularity concern; tests do not claim independence between these features
Tests 1-3 use only pre-snapshot PIT features; no feature represents information that would not be available to a trader at the moment of B0 signal
Test 4 (within-snapshot regime) uses snapshot_anon only to group cases for comparison, not as a predictive feature per rules
Test 5 (hybrid label) is a sensitivity check, not a predictive test; its purpose is to verify the stability of findings under labeling noise
